description: 通过 Nexts Chrome 插件操作用户已登录的 BOSS 直聘招聘页面，为可组合工作流提供搜索、批量去重、简历查看、候选人数据库、筛选评分、报告和候选人沟通工具。数据仅在用户本机处理，不绕过登录或安全验证，沟通工具需要明确确认。
summary: 完整的本地 BOSS 直聘招聘搜索、筛选、报告和沟通工作流。

configuration_fields.label: Chrome bridge token
configuration_fields.description: The local BROWSER_AGENT_BRIDGE_TOKEN configured by the Nexts Chrome plugin.

configuration_fields.label: Local candidate data directory
configuration_fields.description: Stores the candidate database and generated reports locally on the desktop.

configuration_fields.label: Search profile YAML path
configuration_fields.description: Loads keywords, job requirements, filters, and scoring rules from a local YAML file.

operations.name: boss_login
operations.description: Open the recruiter page and check login or verification status.

operations.name: boss_search_candidates
operations.description: Search, scroll, deduplicate, and persist candidates locally.

operations.name: boss_multi_search
operations.description: Run a deduplicated multi-keyword search pipeline with optional automatic viewing.

operations.name: boss_clear_dedup
operations.description: Clear local candidate records by ID, status, date, or all records.

operations.name: boss_view_candidate
operations.description: View a candidate profile URL and save a local screenshot.

operations.name: boss_view_by_index
operations.description: Open a candidate by index, save resume screenshots, and extract a share link when available.

operations.name: boss_view_by_expect_id
operations.description: Find and view a visible candidate by expectId.

operations.name: boss_greet_by_index
operations.description: Contact a candidate by result index after explicit confirmation.

operations.name: boss_evaluate_candidate
operations.description: Evaluate a resume using local job-profile keyword rules.

operations.name: boss_send_greeting
operations.description: Contact a candidate by profile URL after explicit confirmation.

operations.name: boss_update_candidate
operations.description: Update local candidate status, score, notes, or share URL.

operations.name: boss_pipeline_status
operations.description: Return local recruitment-pipeline statistics and recovery suggestions.

operations.name: boss_filter_and_score
operations.description: Filter and score candidates using the local search profile.

operations.name: boss_export_report
operations.description: Export shortlisted candidates as a Markdown report.

operations.name: boss_debug_page
operations.description: Inspect the current BOSS page DOM structure.

operations.name: boss_reload
operations.description: Reload the local candidate database and search profile.
